prompt: Richard, an experienced system administrator, is trying to add a new group to the LDAP directory. He has an LDIF file named `devgroup.ldif` and wants to use simple authentication to perform the addition. Which of the following commands will successfully add the group using simple authentication?
explanation: The `ldapadd` command is used to add entries to the LDAP directory. The `-f` option specifies the input LDIF file. The `-x` option is used for simple authentication instead of SASL, which is the default.
